A new version of the Digital Asset Market Clarity offers tweaks to how the key crypto legislation would address activities by decentralized finance firms and some traditional finance firms engaging in crypto activities, but it isn't expected to represent a final compromise that will win sufficient support from Democrats. The new text, circulated by Republican lawmakers on Thursday, features certain new requirements for decentralized finance entities. The bulk of the text, which aims to reshape how federal regulators oversee cryptocurrency activities in the U.S., seems to largely resemble previous versions of the bill.
